localeTag.description: The BCP 47 tag for this file's own locale. NOT a translation — leave it exactly as it is. The extension reads it to pick the language for country names and for sorting them, because the browser's own UI-language APIs report a different locale than the one these messages were loaded from.

appName.message: X-Pat — X profile location, filter and highlight
appName.description: Store listing title on both Chrome Web Store and AMO. AMO caps this at 50 characters — keep any translation under 50. 'X' is the site name and must not be translated.

appShortName.description: Shown in browser UI where space is tight. This is the product name — leave it as-is unless the script needs transliterating.

appDesc.message: See the country any X profile posts from — country flags, VPN warnings, and country filters, read from X's own data.
appDesc.description: Store listing description. Must match the `description` field in package.json for the English locale.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip on the browser toolbar button.

menuSharePost.description: Right-click menu entry on x.com. Copies the post as an image.

popupPaused.message: Paused. X looks exactly as it would with the extension uninstalled.
popupPaused.description: Shown in the toolbar popup when the master switch is off.

popupOn.description: Master switch state in the popup header. Keep very short.

popupOff.description: Master switch state in the popup header. Keep very short.

popupMasterSwitchTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's master switch.

popupFlagsInFeed.description: Popup toggle: show a country flag under every name in the timeline.

popupAccountDetails.description: Popup toggle: show the account-facts card inside X's hover card.

popupCountryPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the popup's location picker.

popupNothingBlocked.message: Nothing blocked — all flags shown as-is.
popupNothingBlocked.description: Popup empty state when no locations are blocked.

popupHighlightKeywords.description: Popup section title for the keyword list.

popupKeywordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the popup's keyword input.

popupNoKeywords.description: Popup empty state when the keyword list is empty.

popupCacheCount.description: Shown near the bottom of the popup. $1 is a count of accounts, already formatted for the reader's locale (e.g. 12,480). Any number is possible, so languages whose plurals depend on it should reword rather than pick a form — e.g. 'Community cache: $1'.

popupCacheCountTitle.message: Locations other people have already looked up. Yours load from these without asking X.
popupCacheCountTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's community-cache count.

popupAllSettings.description: Popup footer button that opens the full settings page.

popupRate.description: Popup footer link to the store listing. Keep short.

popupRateTitle.message: Rate X-Pat on the Chrome Web Store
popupRateTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's permanent rate link.

popupDonate.description: Popup footer link to the donation page. Keep short.

popupDonateTitle.description: Tooltip on the popup's donate link.

removeItem.description: Tooltip on the × that removes a chip. $1 is a country, region or keyword.

removeHandle.description: Tooltip on the × that removes an account from a list. $1 is an X handle without the @.

openHandle.description: Tooltip on a handle chip that links to the profile. $1 is an X handle without the @.

rateAskText.message: Been useful? A store rating helps a lot.
rateAskText.description: The one-off request for a store rating, shown in the popup.

rateAskInline.message: — been useful? A store rating helps a lot.
rateAskInline.description: Same request, shown on x.com after the product name 'X-Pat'. The leading dash separates it from the name; keep whatever punctuation reads naturally after a product name in your language.

rateAskYes.description: Button that opens the store listing.

rateAskLater.description: Button that snoozes the rating request for two weeks.

rateAskNo.description: Button that declines the rating request permanently.

optionsTitle.description: Heading of the full settings page.

optionsEnabled.description: Master switch state on the settings page.

optionsPaused.description: Master switch state on the settings page.

optionsPausedBanner.message: Paused — nothing below is being applied to X right now.
optionsPausedBanner.description: Banner on the settings page when the master switch is off.

tabAdvanced.description: Settings page tab, hidden unless enabled by URL parameter.

ruleHighlight.description: Name of the highlight rule, used as a heading on the Exceptions tab.

ruleLocation.description: Name of the location rule. Used both as a heading on the Exceptions tab and as the popup's location section title.

ruleAffiliation.description: Name of the affiliation rule, used as a heading on the Exceptions tab.

ruleAge.description: Name of the account-age rule, used as a heading on the Exceptions tab.

cardOnPage.description: Settings card title: what the extension draws on X.

cardOnPageDesc.message: What X-Pat draws on X. None of this changes which posts are filtered.

setShowInFeedDesc.message: A flag under every name in the timeline, not only on hover.

setAccountCardDesc.message: Account age, affiliate badge, verification, handle changes and follower count — read from data X already sent, so it costs no extra lookups.

setCopyButton.description: Setting label. The quoted word matches the button's own label — translate both together.

setCopyButtonDesc.message: A small “Copy” button in the flags row. Copies the post you hovered from, together with the flags, as an image — rendered in your browser, nothing uploaded. Right-clicking a post does the same thing.

setExceptionButtonDesc.message: A one-click exemption for the account you are looking at, from whichever rules are acting on it — the keyword highlight, the country, the affiliate badge, the age. Its tooltip says which.

hintSwipe.message: 👉 Swipe right on any post to fetch its location.
hintSwipe.description: Hint shown on mobile browsers only.

cardAppearanceDesc.message: Covers X-Pat's own screens — this page and the toolbar popup. The flags and marks drawn on X follow X's theme instead, so they never clash with the timeline they sit in.

setTheme.description: Setting label for the light/dark selector.

themeSystem.description: Theme option: follow the operating system setting.

setLanguage.description: Setting label for the extension's own language.

setLanguageDesc.message: Covers X-Pat's own text and the country names it shows. Choosing one reloads this page.
setLanguageDesc.description: Setting description under the language selector.

languageAuto.description: The default language option: follow whatever the browser is set to. Every other option in this list is named in its own language, so this is the only one to translate.

cardKeywordDesc.message: Marks posts whose author's name or bio contains any of these. Highlighting marks a post; it never hides one.

keywordPlaceholder.message: Type a keyword or pick a suggestion…
keywordPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the settings page keyword input.

emptyNoKeywords.message: No keywords set — all posts shown normally.
emptyNoKeywords.description: Empty state under the keyword list.

kwMatchWhole.description: Keyword match mode, shown inside the keyword badge: the keyword must stand on its own. Any punctuation around it, an underscore included, counts as a separator.

kwMatchPartial.description: Keyword match mode, shown inside the keyword badge: the keyword also matches inside a longer word or hashtag.

kwMatchNewLabel.message: How the next keyword is matched
kwMatchNewLabel.description: Accessible label for the match-mode select beside the "add a keyword" input. The choice applies to keywords added from now on; an existing one is changed from its own badge.

kwMatchLabel.description: Accessible label for the match-mode select on a keyword badge. $1 is the keyword.

cardLocationsDesc.message: These show ⚠️ instead of their flag. Goes by the store country, or the account location when it isn't flagged as VPN. Never applies to the post you opened.

locationPlaceholder.message: Search countries and regions — name, code or nickname…
locationPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the settings page location picker.

regionCountries.description: Note beside a region in the location picker. $1 is how many countries the region covers.

emptyNoLocations.message: No locations selected — all flags shown as-is.
emptyNoLocations.description: Empty state under the location list.

cardFiltered.message: What happens to a filtered post

cardFilteredDesc.message: Applies to the two filters that take a post away — blocked locations and blocked affiliations. Account age and keyword highlighting mark a post whatever this is set to. A quoted post is collapsed on its own, so the post quoting it stays readable, and people lists are marked rather than hidden — removing rows there breaks the counts.

filteredPosts.description: Label on the selector that decides what happens to a filtered post. Used in both the popup and the settings page.

hideModeCollapse.description: Filtered-post mode, popup wording. Keep short.

hideModeCollapseLong.description: Filtered-post mode, settings page wording. The quoted word is the button label on the collapsed post — translate it the same way as hiddenShow.

hideModeHide.description: Filtered-post mode, popup wording. Keep short.

cardAffiliationsDesc.message: X badges some accounts as belonging to an organisation. Enter the parent account's handle to filter every account badged with it at once.

affiliationPlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the affiliation input. 'nasa' is an example X handle — leave it as-is.

emptyNoAffiliations.message: No affiliations blocked. Hover an account to see whether it carries a badge.
emptyNoAffiliations.description: Empty state under the affiliation list.

cardAgeDesc.message: How long the account has existed, from the creation date X reports. This one marks posts and never hides them, whatever the setting above says.

setMarkYoungDesc.message: Marks their posts the same way a keyword match does, with the orange bar down the side. It stops there on purpose: a young account is the strongest single signal for a bought or farmed one, and it is also exactly what somebody who joined last month looks like — too thin an excuse to take their replies away.

setMarkYoungerThan.description: Setting label, read as a sentence continuing into the selector beside it (e.g. '… younger than | 6 months').

cardFlags.description: Settings card title. 'Flags' here means flag emoji in a profile bio.

cardFlagsDesc.message: Marks posts whose author's bio is full of flag emoji.

setFlagThreshold.description: Setting label, read as a sentence continuing into the number input beside it.

setUniqueFlags.description: Setting label: count 🇺🇸🇺🇸🇺🇸 as one flag rather than three.

cardAlwaysShow.description: Settings card title for the allowlist.

cardAlwaysShowDesc.message: Exempt from every rule at once — never hidden, never collapsed, never highlighted, whatever the filters say.

usernamePlaceholder.description: Placeholder in the inputs that take an X handle.

emptyNoAllowlist.message: Nobody on the allowlist — every account is judged by the rules.

cardPerRuleDesc.message: Exempt an account from one rule but not the others — for someone using a tracked keyword sarcastically (“no NAFO”), or posting from a blocked country you still want to read.
cardPerRuleDesc.description: Settings card description. 'NAFO' is an example keyword — leave it as-is.

searchExceptions.description: Placeholder in the exception search box.

searchExceptionsLabel.description: Accessible name for the exception search box.

emptyNoMatch.description: Shown when the exception search matches nothing. $1 is what the user typed.

emptyNoExceptions.description: Empty state under one rule's exception list.

cardLookupsDesc.message: X allows about $1 account lookups every $2 minutes. These settings decide how much of that X-Pat may spend filling flags in for you, and how much is held back for the accounts you hover yourself.
cardLookupsDesc.description: Settings card description. $1 is a number of lookups, $2 a number of minutes.

setSharedCacheDesc.message: Shares the flags you look up so everyone skips repeat lookups. Only public handles and their flag are sent — no account or personal data.

setPrefetchDesc.message: Looks up accounts in your feed, in the order they appear, so flags show up without hovering.

setShare.message: Share of the lookup limit it may use

setShareDesc.message: $1 for prefetching, $2 left for your own hovers.
setShareDesc.description: Setting description. $1 and $2 are counts of lookups.

setSpread.message: Spread lookups over the whole $1 minutes
setSpread.description: Setting label. $1 is a number of minutes.

setSpreadDesc.message: About one lookup every $1s, instead of all at once.
setSpreadDesc.description: Setting description. $1 is a number of seconds; the 's' is the unit abbreviation.

cardBackupDesc.message: Move your settings to another browser, or keep a copy before experimenting.

btnExport.description: Button that downloads a settings file.

btnImport.description: Button that opens a file picker.

hintImportMerge.message: Import merges: settings the file doesn't mention are left alone. Every value is re-checked on the way in, so a hand-edited file can't put the extension into a state it can't recover from.
hintImportMerge.description: Explanatory note under the import and export buttons.

noteExported.message: Exported $1 settings. The shared-cache id and your cached locations are not included.
noteExported.description: Confirmation after an export. $1 is how many settings were written.

noteImported.description: Confirmation after an import. $1 is how many settings were applied.

noteImportedSkipped.description: Appended after noteImported when the file held keys this version does not know. $1 is a count.

errImportFailed.message: That file could not be imported.
errImportFailed.description: Fallback error when an import fails for an unexpected reason.

errNotJson.message: That file is not valid JSON.

errNotExport.message: That file is not a settings export.

errNoSection.message: That file is missing its "settings" section, so it is not an export from this extension.
errNoSection.description: Import error. The quoted word is a key inside the file — leave it in English.

errNewerFormat.message: That file was written by a newer version (format $1). Update the extension first.
errNewerFormat.description: Import error. $1 is a format number.

errNoSettings.message: That file contains no settings to import.

cardCacheDesc.message: Locations you have looked up are kept in this browser for 30 days, so showing them again costs nothing.

btnClearCache.description: Button that empties the local cache.

btnCacheCleared.description: Momentary confirmation shown on the button after it is pressed.

cardTrustDesc.message: How many independent reports of the same location this install requires before trusting it. Higher is harder to poison but answers far less: today only about 1 in 80 cached profiles has been reported twice, so anything above 1 mostly falls back to looking the account up on X and spends your rate limit. Leave it at $1 unless you are measuring this.
cardTrustDesc.description: Settings card description. $1 is the default value.

setTrustAfter.description: Setting label, read as a sentence continuing into the selector beside it (e.g. '… after | 2 reports').

trustReports1.description: Option in the trust selector. Written out in full rather than as a placeholder so languages with several plural forms can phrase each one correctly.

ageDays.description: Option in the account-age selector. $1 is always 60 or more, so no singular form is needed.

ageMonths.description: Option in the account-age selector. $1 is always 2 or more.

ageYear.description: Option in the account-age selector, for exactly one year.

ageYears.description: Option in the account-age selector. $1 is 1.5 or more and may be fractional (e.g. 2.5).

ageToday.description: Account age, on a chip in the hover card: the account was created today.

ageShortDays.description: Account age, abbreviated for a chip. $1 is 1–59. Use the shortest unmistakable abbreviation for days in your language.

ageShortMonths.description: Account age, abbreviated for a chip. $1 is 2–23. Use the shortest unmistakable abbreviation for months.

ageShortYears.description: Account age, abbreviated for a chip. $1 is 2 or more. Use the shortest unmistakable abbreviation for years.

toastDismiss.description: Tooltip on the rate-limit countdown shown over x.com.

toastRateLimit.description: Countdown shown over x.com when X stops answering lookups. $1 is a duration like '3m 20s'.

countdownMinSec.description: A duration of a minute or more. $1 is minutes, $2 is seconds; 'm' and 's' are unit abbreviations.

countdownSec.description: A duration under a minute. $1 is seconds; 's' is the unit abbreviation.

rateLimitBadgeTitle.message: X API rate limit reached — location lookups paused until reset
rateLimitBadgeTitle.description: Tooltip on the countdown badge inside a hover card.

vpnBadge.description: Badge next to a location X declined to verify. 'VPN' is used as-is in most languages.

vpnTitle.message: VPN used, location can be inaccurate

storeRegionLabel.description: Accessible name for the app-store badge. $1 is a store name ('App Store', 'Android', 'Web'), $2 a country.

platformWeb.description: Where the account posts from: a browser rather than a phone app.

platformUnknown.description: Where the account posts from, when X says nothing.

hiddenLabel.description: Label on a collapsed post. $1 is a flag or icon, $2 the reason (a country, an organisation, an age).

hiddenShow.description: Button that reveals one collapsed post. Keep short — it sits inline. Translate hideModeCollapseLong to match.

hiddenShowTitle.description: Tooltip on the reveal button. $1 is a rule name (see ruleNameLocation and friends), $2 what it matched.

cellTagTitle.description: Tooltip on a tag in a followers or search-people list. $1 is a rule name (see ruleNameLocation and friends).

ruleNameHighlight.description: Rule name as it appears mid-sentence, after 'Matches your …'. Lower case in English.

ruleNameLocation.description: Rule name as it appears mid-sentence, after 'Matches your …'. Lower case in English.

ruleNameAffiliation.description: Rule name as it appears mid-sentence, after 'Matches your …'. Lower case in English.

ruleNameAge.description: Rule name as it appears mid-sentence, after 'Matches your …'. Lower case in English.

excAdd.description: Button on a hover card that exempts this account from every rule acting on it.

excUndo.description: The same button once the exception exists — pressing it again removes the exception.

excAddTitle.description: Tooltip on the exception button. $1 is an X handle without the @, $2 a list of rule phrases (see excPhraseLocation and friends).

excUndoTitle.message: @$1 is exempt from $2 — click to undo
excUndoTitle.description: Tooltip on the exception button once the exception exists. $1 is an X handle without the @, $2 a list of rule phrases.

excPhraseHighlight.description: Rule phrase, written to read after 'Exempt @user from …'.

excPhraseLocation.description: Rule phrase, written to read after 'Exempt @user from …'.

excPhraseAffiliation.description: Rule phrase, written to read after 'Exempt @user from …'.

excPhraseAge.description: Rule phrase, written to read after 'Exempt @user from …'.

joinAnd.description: Joins the last two items of a list of rule phrases. $1 is everything before the last item, already comma-separated; $2 is the last item.

chipBlockedYou.description: Hover-card chip: this account has blocked the reader.

chipAge.description: Hover-card chip showing account age. $1 is an abbreviated age such as '3mo'.

chipAgeTitle.description: Tooltip on the age chip. $1 is a date in YYYY-MM-DD form.

chipAffiliation.description: Hover-card chip showing the organisation X badges this account with. $1 is the organisation name or handle.

chipAffiliationTitleHandle.message: X shows an affiliate badge linking to @$1
chipAffiliationTitleHandle.description: Tooltip on the affiliation chip. $1 is an X handle without the @.

chipAffiliationTitle.message: X shows an affiliate badge on this account
chipAffiliationTitle.description: Tooltip on the affiliation chip when X names no parent account.

chipIdVerified.description: Hover-card chip: X checked an identity document, as opposed to a paid blue check.

chipVerified.description: Hover-card chip: verification from before X made it a paid feature.

chipVerifiedTitle.description: Tooltip on the legacy verification chip.

chipHandle1.description: Hover-card chip: the account has changed its @handle once.

chipHandles.description: Hover-card chip: how many times the account has changed its @handle. $1 is 2 or more.

chipHandlesTitle.message: This account has changed its @handle $1 time(s)
chipHandlesTitle.description: Tooltip on the handle-changes chip. $1 is a count.

chipProtected.description: Hover-card chip: the account's posts are visible to followers only.

bioTitle.message: Bio from X's API — this card doesn't show one
bioTitle.description: Tooltip on a bio the extension restored because X's hover card omitted it.

shareBtn.description: Button in the hover card's flags row. Copies the post as an image. Keep short. Translate setCopyButton to match.

shareBtnTitle.message: Copy this post and what X reports for @$1 as an image
shareBtnTitle.description: Tooltip on the copy button. $1 is an X handle without the @.

toastRendering.description: Shown while the image is being drawn. $1 is an X handle without the @.

toastCopied.description: Confirmation after the image reached the clipboard.

toastSaved.description: Confirmation after the image was downloaded instead, because the clipboard was unavailable.

toastRenderFail.description: Shown when drawing the image failed.

toastRightClick.message: Right-click a post to share it
toastRightClick.description: Shown when the share command ran with no post to act on.

toastReadFail.description: Shown when the post's author could not be identified.

toastNoLocation.description: Shown after a swipe when X reports nothing about the account.

toastLookingUp.description: Shown while a swipe's lookup is in flight. $1 is an X handle without the @.

regionEastAsiaPacific.description: A region in the location picker. Every other region and every country name comes from the browser's own locale data; these two have no standard code, so they are translated here.

regionEasternEuropeNonEu.description: A region in the location picker: European countries outside the European Union.
